mapper.insert: insert into course(name, content, score, teacher_id, num, time, location, college_id, already_num, class_id, term) values ( #{name}, #{content}, #{score}, #{teacherId}, #{num}, #{time}, #{location}, #{collegeId}, #{alreadyNum}, #{classId}, #{term} )
mapper.update: update course set name = #{name}, content = #{content}, score = #{score}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, num = #{num}, time = #{time}, location = #{location}, college_id = #{collegeId}, already_num = #{alreadyNum}, class_id = #{classId}, term = #{term} where id = #{id}

insert.foreach: INSERT INTO course (name, content, score, teacher_id, num, time, location, class_id, college_id, already_num, term) VALUES ( #{item.name}, #{item.content}, #{item.score}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.num}, #{item.time}, #{item.location}, #{item.classId}, #{item.collegeId}, #{item.alreadyNum}, #{item.term} )

mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, t.name AS teacherName, co.name AS collegeName, clz.name AS className FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN college co ON c.college_id = co.id LEFT JOIN clazz clz ON c.class_id = clz.id
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
